$comment: Shared 社會 course (社會綜合): cross-subject chapters and the original 社會 practice paper. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track. Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: social
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required subject in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
Owner (2026-11-28): a separate 社會綜合 course holds the shared part (two cross-subject chapters and an original 110-minute 社會 practice paper), as inquiry holds the 自然 mock.
合科 items were about 56% of items in 114 and about 40% of the score in 115 (CEEC 試題特色, research), so cross-subject reading gets its own chapters.
Practice papers are original and only modelled on the 111–115 layout (papers.json); official papers are linked, never copied.
openQuestions: Subject accent colour for 社會綜合 (subjects.css): a new colour is a look change; to be proposed to the owner before these chapters are built.

Mock layout: 111–115 differ (Part 1 38–46 單選; Part 2 8–11 混合題組 with 10–11 written items; 144 points customary, not fixed by rule). The mock follows the 115 layout unless the owner prefers another year.

title.en: Across 社會, and a practice paper

question.zh-tw: 一題看起來像歷史，考的卻可能是公民：怎麼看出每一小題真正考的是哪一科？
question.en: An item that looks like history may test civics: how do you see which subject each part really tests?

parts.whyHere: After all three subjects (prereqs: their exam-skills chapters), as the inquiry part follows the four sciences.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修歷史、地理與公民、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required history, geography and civics in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

blurb.zh-tw: 拆解合科題組：判斷每一小題考的是哪一科的概念，並用歷史、地理、公民三種視角分析同一情境。
blurb.en: Taking apart a cross-subject group: which subject's concept each part tests, and one context read through history, geography and civics.

objectives.zh-tw: 判斷合科題組中每一小題實際考的是哪一科的概念
objectives.en: Tell which subject's concept each part of a cross-subject group really tests

objectives.zh-tw: 用歷史、地理與公民三種視角分析同一個情境
objectives.en: Analyse one context through history, geography and civics

objectives.zh-tw: 避免只靠情境的科目外觀或關鍵字作答
objectives.en: Avoid answering from the context's look or from keywords alone

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Model: inquiry/s116x-one-context-four-subjects. 114 試題特色: some history-looking items tested civics or geography. The worked analogue is original, modelled on 考試說明 例題2 (歷Mb-Ⅴ-3 / 公Df-Ⅴ-2 / 地Be-Ⅴ-1, Argentina/Venezuela), which is linked, not copied.

title.zh-tw: 社會混合題組與非選作答
title.en: 社會 mixed groups and written answers

blurb.zh-tw: 讀懂跨科混合題組的題幹與資料、分配作答時間，以及三科共通的等級評分非選寫法。
blurb.en: Reading the stems and data of cross-subject mixed groups, pacing the paper, and the level-scored written answer the three subjects share.

objectives.zh-tw: 讀懂混合題組的題幹與多份資料，找出每一小題要用的資料
objectives.en: Read a mixed group's stem and sources, and find the data each part needs

objectives.zh-tw: 依等級評分原則寫出概念與理由兼具、符合字數限制的答案
objectives.en: Write answers that give both concept and reason within the word limit, as the level rubrics require

objectives.zh-tw: 在 110 分鐘內分配第壹、貳部分的作答時間
objectives.en: Pace Parts 1 and 2 within the 110 minutes

chapters.activity: Exam-skills chapter (model: earth/s116-earth-data-items). Rubric levels 等級2/1/0 from the 113 rubric; written items carried 36/144 points in 113–115 (research). States the shared rules and links each subject's exam-skills chapter instead of re-teaching it.

blurb.zh-tw: 題型與配分仿照 111–115 學年度試卷的原創社會模擬卷。
blurb.en: An original Social Studies practice paper laid out like the 111–115 papers.

objectives.zh-tw: 在限時內完成一份完整的社會模擬卷
objectives.en: Complete a full Social Studies practice paper against the clock

objectives.zh-tw: 對照詳解找出要回頭複習的章節
objectives.en: Use the worked solutions to find the chapters to revisit

chapters.activity: Model: inquiry/s116-sci-mock (written by subject part-writers with fixed item numbers plus an assembler). Original full paper laid out like the 115 paper (layout facts from src/data/registry/exam/papers.json): Part 1 單選, Part 2 混合題組 with written items near 25% of the points; the three subjects balanced and a 合科 share like recent papers; worked solutions name their review chapter.
